mapper.select: SELECT id,tenant_id,batch_id,filename,encrypted_content,content_hash,status,stage,candidate_id,error_code,progress FROM ai_hr_batch_item WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND candidate_id=#{candidate} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id,tenant_id,payload,version,created_at FROM ai_hr_policy_version WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id,tenant_id,payload,version,created_at FROM ai_hr_policy_version WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
SELECT FROM ai_hr_batch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
SELECT FROM ai_hr_batch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT b.id,b.tenant_id,b.department_id,b.user_id,b.position_id,b.mode,b.policy_id,b.maximum_items,b.status,b.version,b.created_at,b.idempotency_key,b.request_hash FROM ai_hr_batch b JOIN ai_hr_batch_item i ON i.batch_id=b.id AND i.tenant_id=b.tenant_id WHERE b.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND i.candidate_id=#{candidate} ORDER BY b.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM ai_hr_batch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND idempotency_key=#{key}
SELECT FROM ai_hr_batch_item WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND batch_id=#{id} ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM ai_hr_batch_item WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_hr_batch SET status=#{to},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{expected} AND status=#{from}

UPDATE ai_hr_batch_item SET status=#{to},stage=#{stage},candidate_id=COALESCE(#{candidate},candidate_id),error_code=#{error},progress=#{progress},encrypted_content=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND status=#{from}
UPDATE ai_hr_batch SET status='COMPLETED',version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING'
UPDATE ai_hr_batch SET status='CANCELLED',version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND status IN ('DRAFT','RUNNING')
UPDATE ai_hr_batch SET status='CANCEL_PENDING',version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND status='CANCELLED'
UPDATE ai_hr_batch SET status='BLOCKED',version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING'
